newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai police smash drug trafficking ring.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai police smash drug trafficking ring.

text.p: Shanghai police have arrested eight members of a drug trafficking ring and seized 235 grammes of heroin and 120 grammes of cannabis, the semi-official China News Services reported on Thursday.
Police in charge of the case declined to commment.
The agency said police arrested three men and seized 107 grammes of heroin during a raid on a hotel in the city a few days ago, and also caught a buyer who had come to meet the three detainees.
During interrogations, police gained more information that led to the arrest of four other people and the seizure of another 120 grammes of cannabis and 128 grammes of heroin, the agency said.
